content: opentelemetry-api/sdk 1.44.0 current, opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi 0.65b0 (still beta/0bX versioning). Setup via opentelemetry-distro + opentelemetry-exporter-otlp, run opentelemetry-bootstrap --action=install then launch with opentelemetry-instrument uvicorn app.main:app. Export via OTLP (grpc 4317/http 4318) to Jaeger all-in-one (jaegertracing/all-in-one, current 1.76.0) which now natively accepts OTLP.
